WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess
  FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT k.avg_fill, k.first_excess, k.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS second_excess
  FROM first_kept k CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE k.avg_fill > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS average_per_order_fill_quantity,
       AVG(first_excess) AS average_first_excess,
       AVG(second_excess) AS average_second_excess
FROM final_kept;
